questions.stem: —____ you ____ your homework yet? —Yes, I ____ it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 【解析】第一空考查现在完成时，yet是现在完成时的标志词，结构为have/has+过去分词；第二空考查一般过去时，ago是一般过去时的标志词，用动词过去式finished。【错因】A选项第一空用Did，与yet搭配错误；C选项第二空用have finished，与ago矛盾；D选项两个时态都用错。【技巧】口诀：'现完看yet/already/never/ever，过去看ago/yesterday/last'，时间标志词是判断时态的关键。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ____ cover is red is mine.
questions.explanation: 【解析】考查定语从句关系词。先行词是the book，与cover构成所属关系（书皮），应用whose表示'……的'，在从句中作定语。【错因】A选项who指人；B选项which在从句中作主语或宾语；C选项that在从句中作主语或宾语，都不能表示所属关系。【技巧】whose=the+名词+of+which/whom，表示所属关系，后必须接名词。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These old buildings ____ by the government next year.
questions.explanation: 【解析】考查一般将来时的被动语态。主语buildings与rebuild是被动关系，时间状语next year表示将来，结构为will be+过去分词。【错因】A选项是主动语态；C选项是现在进行时主动语态；D选项是一般现在时主动语态，均未体现被动。【技巧】被动语态三步走：1. 判断主谓关系（被动？）2. 确定时态 3. 结构：be+done（注意时态变化）。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ____ belong to Lucy because her name is on it, but I'm not sure if she ____ have finished reading it.
questions.explanation: 【解析】第一空考查must表肯定推测（一定是），因为有证据（名字在书上）；第二空考查might表不确定推测（可能），因为'I'm not sure'表示不确定。【错因】A选项第二空must太绝对；C选项第一空might与证据矛盾；D选项第一空can't表否定推测，与句意相反。【技巧】推测语气强度：must（一定）> may/might（可能）> can't（不可能），根据证据强度和语境选择。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The ____ news made all of us very ____.
questions.explanation: 【解析】exciting修饰物（news），表示'令人兴奋的'；excited修饰人（us），表示'感到兴奋的'。【错因】A选项修饰对象颠倒；C选项第一空错误；D选项第二空错误。【技巧】-ing形容词主语是物，-ed形容词主语是人，口诀：'ing使人感到，ed自己感到'。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: If you 'rewrite' a composition, you write it ____.
questions.explanation: 【解析】前缀re-表示'again（再次）'，rewrite=write again。【错因】其他选项未体现re-的含义。【技巧】常见前缀：re-（再次/回），un-（不），dis-（不/相反），im-（不）；后缀：-ful（充满），-less（无），-tion（名词）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We need to ____ a solution to stop pollution in our city.
questions.explanation: 【解析】come up with意为'想出（主意、办法）'，符合句意'想出解决办法'。【错因】B选项catch up with意为'赶上'；C选项keep up with意为'跟上/保持同步'；D选项put up with意为'忍受'，均不符合语境。【技巧】up短语辨析：come up with（想出），catch up with（赶上），keep up with（跟上），put up with（忍受），make up with（和好）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 【解析】start a project意为'启动项目'，是固定搭配。begin虽然也有开始之意，但begin a project不如start常用；hold a project（举办）和keep a project（保持）不符合语境。【技巧】完形填空注意动词与名词的搭配习惯，project常与start/launch搭配。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage: Last month, our school (8)____ an interesting project called "Green Campus". The project was designed to help students understand the importance of (9)____ our environment. Every day, students collect plastic bottles and waste paper from each classroom. (10)____ it takes a lot of time and effort, everyone enjoys doing it. We clean and sort the waste carefully. Then, we (11)____ some of the plastic bottles into flower pots. It is amazing to see how (12)____ waste can become beautiful art. Through this project, we learn that protecting the Earth starts with small actions.

questions.explanation: 【解析】protect the environment是固定搭配'保护环境'。save侧重'拯救/节约'，不如protect贴切；make（制造）和use（使用）与语境相反。【技巧】环保类文章高频搭配：protect the environment（保护环境），save energy（节约能源），reduce pollution（减少污染）。

questions.explanation: 【解析】Although引导让步状语从句，表示'虽然……但是……'，符合逻辑'虽然耗时费力，但大家都喜欢'。Because表原因，与enjoy矛盾；If表条件；So表结果，均不符合。【技巧】完形填空逻辑关系题看前后句意是否转折、因果、条件等，此处'takes time'与'enjoys'形成转折。

questions.explanation: 【解析】turn...into...是固定短语'把……变成……'，turn bottles into pots（把瓶子变成花盆）。change...into...虽然也有'变成'之意，但turn更强调性质完全改变，符合'变废为宝'的语境。【技巧】turn into强调转变结果，change into强调变化过程，完形中turn into更常用。

questions.stem: What does the brain do during sleep according to the passage?
options: B. It processes information and stores knowledge.
C. It only rests and does nothing.
D. It forgets all the information from the day.
questions.explanation: 【解析】细节题。根据第二段'During sleep, our brains are still working. They process the information we learned during the day and move it from short-term memory to long-term memory.'可知，大脑在睡眠时处理信息并储存知识。【错因】A、C选项与'still working'矛盾；D选项与文意相反。【技巧】细节题定位法：先读题干关键词（brain/during sleep），回原文找对应句（第二段前两句），比对选项与原文的同义转换（store=move to long-term memory）。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Do you often stay up late to study for exams? Many students believe that the more time they spend studying, the better grades they will get. However, scientists have found that sleep plays an important role in learning.

During sleep, our brains are still working. They process (处理) the information we learned during the day and move it from short-term memory to long-term memory. A study shows that students who get enough sleep before a test usually perform better than those who stay up all night. This is because their brains have had time to organize and store the knowledge properly.

Dr. Smith, a sleep researcher, explains, "When you sleep, your brain is like a librarian (图书管理员) putting books on the right shelves. If you don't sleep, the books stay on the floor in a mess."

So, if you want to improve your memory and get good grades, don't cut your sleep time. Go to bed early and let your brain do its job. Remember, good sleep habits are just as important as good study habits.

questions.stem: What can we infer from Dr. Smith's words?
options: A. Librarians need to sleep well to work.
B. Sleeping helps organize our memories.
C. Books should be put on shelves before sleeping.
D. Students should study in libraries.
questions.explanation: 【解析】推理题。Smith博士将大脑比作图书管理员，将记忆比作书籍，说明睡眠时大脑像管理员整理书籍一样整理记忆。因此可推断睡眠有助于整理记忆。【错因】A、C、D选项都停留在字面意思，没有理解比喻的深层含义。【技巧】推理题要透过字面看本质，识别修辞手法（比喻），理解作者真实意图，避免就事论事。
